claims.text: Harry Frankfurt, trong The Reasons of Love (2004): yêu ai đó là quan tâm đến hạnh phúc của người đó vì chính người đó ... (disinterested concern); cha mẹ thức trắng đêm vì con ốm

sources.quote: The lover seeks the good of the beloved for its own sake, not merely for the sake of some ulterior purpose.

sources.quote: love is not under our direct and immediate voluntary control. What we love is not simply a matter of choice or up to us.

sources.quote: Love disarms our emotional defenses; it makes us vulnerable to the other.
On this Kantian view, our dignity as persons consists in our rational nature
the contingent fit between the way some people behaviorally express their dignity as persons and the way I happen to respond to those expressions

claims.text: Phản bác (Velleman): vì sao không yêu mọi người như nhau? ... "sự chú ý đặc biệt" ... cuối cùng vẫn là ngẫu nhiên

sources.quote: my responding with love in these cases is a matter of my “really seeing” this person in a way that I fail to do with others
This understanding of the selectivity of love as something that can be explained but not justified is potentially troubling.
